title: Nvidia signs new cloud commitment with Oracle

sources.quote: “Remaining Performance Obligations (RPO) increased by $68 billion in Q2—up 15% sequentially to $523 billion—highlighted by new commitments from Meta, NVIDIA, and others,” said Oracle Principal Financial Officer, Doug Kehring.

explain: Nvidia, which sells the chips inside Oracle's data centers, also buys computing back from Oracle's cloud. Oracle named Nvidia as one of the customers behind a $68 billion jump in its contracted backlog in late 2025, without saying how much Nvidia committed.
